msg: I chose the coloured gnome which gave most mushrooms, I then kept choosing that colour until the amount of mushrooms reduced, I then picked a different colour and kept with that colour gnome until that one's mushrooms reduced. This worked really well for me and I kept repeating this throughout the game. There is no break, therefore try to keep your concentration throughout - I did well but I did miss clicking on a couple of baskets nearer the end as I could feel myself getting a bit slower.
